verdict.rationale: The Jobs v2 create endpoint documents direct file upload for local media up to 2 GiB, and the site states a 24-hour duration limit, so the submission path and size limits are published. Accepted formats are described only generically as audio-only and video files with audio tracks; the pack contains no published list of container or codec formats, so the formats requirement is only partly met. missing for 10: an explicit published list of accepted file formats/codecs, evidence that video uploads specifically work through the upload method (the upload doc says "audio file"), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a local audio or video file for transcription through a documented API endpoint, with accepted formats and size limits published

citations.quote: Upload a file: Upload an audio file directly. This method supports files up to 2 GiB and is ideal for large files or local media.
Transcribe long-form audio files up to 24 hours or 2 GiB in size.
both audio-only and video files with audio tracks are accepted.
